text:
meera: heads up — new firewall rule went into prod in usw4 ~10m ago. noticed llm-warmup jobs failing to reach our log-shipper. GPU pools not finishing warmup.
meera: stacktrace from allocator: `ERROR: failed to upload init-metrics to https://siem-usw4.redwood.local:403`
alex: confirming, saw ~30% of gpu-u12 nodes stuck in onboarding state. logs show TLS handshake failures to siem-proxy.
luis: I'm on it. quick check — can anyone ping siem-proxy from a stuck node?
annie: ran `curl -v https://siem-usw4.redwood.local/health` from a node -> `* TLS handshake: alert handshake failure` then `* Connection reset by peer`
ops-bot: alert: warmup-failure-usw4 triggered (15 nodes), severity: high
meera: security rolled out a DENY rule for outbound 10.99.0.0/16 yesterday evening to lock down internal logging endpoints. I think the proxy sits in that CIDR.
security: confirmed. we pushed temporary deny on outbound to that subnet as part of hardened egress baseline. Noticed some downstream services talk to that network and asked for a PR to whitelist later.
alex: this is bad — GPU onboarding depends on metrics reaching SIEM for attestation. If we keep this deny, customers will see slow starts. cost of idle GPUs skyrockets.
luis: two options: 1) open a targeted allow for siem-proxy IPs in usc4, 2) route logs through a different egress path (proxying via log-gw in control plane). Which is faster?
security: allow is fastest. we can add a single rule: `allow tcp 443 to 10.99.12.34` but need change control + justification.
annie: can we do a temporary port-forward on the node to send logs to a public endpoint? that avoids touching FW rules but risks data leaving VPC. Not ideal.
meera: don't send logs externally. We need the fast mitigation but compliant. Suggest allow to specific IPs + tag only compute nodes in the warmpool.
alex: I'll prepare a terraform plan with a temporary rule scoped to `tag=warmup=true` and IP set. then we can rollback within 1h after verifying warmup.
ops-bot: runbook step: if warmup completes -> close the allow and open a ticket to implement permanent proxy path.
luis: pinging security for expedited review: @security can you approve a scoped allow for 1 hour for tag=warmup=true to 10.99.12.34:443?
security: approve for 1 hour, audit note required. Please include PR with purpose + PM approval.
annie: PR created: `infra/allow-warmup-siem-usw4` — plan attached. snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "allow_warmup_siem" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["10.99.12.34/32"]
  description       = "temporary allow for warmup telemetry to SIEM proxy - 1h"
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.compute_warmup.id
}
```
alex: applying now to staging then prod with canary 5 nodes.
deploy-bot: started apply infra/allow-warmup-siem on staging at 1832004355 by alex
luis: staging nodes resumed warmup, metrics ingested. rolling to canary in prod (5 nodes).
meera: we should also enable verbose logging on allocator to catch any other failures. `ALLOC_LOG_LEVEL=debug` for canary.
ops-bot: canary check: 5/5 nodes warmed successfully at 1832004450
meera: good. prod rollout continuing. please keep an eye on cost dashboards.
security: logging audit note: temporary rule approved by security (meera/alex/luis), motived by critical warmup failure blocking GPU onboarding. rule TTL 1h.
luis: prod canary 5 -> 25 -> 100 nodes completed. warmpool stabilizing.
anne: after rollback we need follow-up: implement internal nat egress path for SIEM to keep deny baseline. opening ticket infra#4521.
alex: rolling back rule now (will remove the temp rule and implement route for later).
deploy-bot: completed destroy infra/allow-warmup-siem at 1832004505 by alex
meera: postmortem notes: root cause = overly-broad deny on internal logging subnet. mitigated with scoped allow + short-lived exception. action items: 1) infra#4521 implement siem egress gateway 2) security to add exception process doc 3) add e2e test that warmup can reach siem via new path.
luis: closing the alert. thanks all :thumbsup:
